languages.name: Norsk
languages.marketNotes: Write for job seekers in Norway, in natural Norwegian Bokmål. Norwegian conventions: a 'søknad' (cover letter, usually max one page) plus a CV in reverse chronological order; applications are usually submitted through the employer's or recruiter's online form; a photo in the CV is optional and common but not expected. Job portals you may mention by name: FINN.no (Finn jobb), arbeidsplassen.no (run by NAV), LinkedIn. NAV is the public employment and welfare service. Do not state NAV rules, benefit amounts, deadlines or legal requirements.

ui.ctaText: Last opp CV-en din, lim inn en stillingsannonse og få en ærlig vurdering av hvor godt du passer – og en CV og søknad tilpasset jobben.
ui.hubTitle: Artikler om CV, søknad og jobbintervju
ui.hubDescription: Praktiske råd om CV, jobbsøknad og intervju for deg som søker jobb i Norge.
ui.cookieText: Vi vil gjerne bruke Google Analytics-informasjonskapsler for å se hvordan nettsiden brukes. Ingenting lagres eller sendes før du godtar.

languages.name: English
languages.market: People applying for jobs in Norway in English: international students, newcomers, labour migrants and international job seekers
languages.marketNotes: Write in clear, plain international English for people who are applying for jobs IN NORWAY in English: international students, newcomers, labour migrants and international job seekers. Do not write for a general or British audience. Every article must give concrete Norwegian guidance where relevant: where to find jobs (FINN.no, arbeidsplassen.no run by NAV, LinkedIn); Norwegian CV norms (reverse chronological order, usually one to two pages, a photo is optional and not required, references are commonly listed with name, role and phone number or offered on request); the Norwegian job application (søknad), usually max one page, direct, honest and modest, addressed to a named contact person when the ad gives one; that many ads ask for Norwegian language skills, and how to describe your own Norwegian level honestly (for example with the CEFR scale A1–C2 if you know your level, or plain words such as 'basic', 'conversational', 'fluent', and what you are doing to improve). It is fine to explain Norwegian words the reader will meet in ads (søknad, søknadsfrist, stillingsannonse, referanser). Do NOT state rules about work permits, residence, NAV benefits, taxes, salaries or language-test requirements; if something cannot be verified, leave it out. Avoid British-specific or US-specific terms; in particular never use 'charity shop', 'food bank', 'BSc', 'dissertation' or 'modules', and never 'secondary school' on its own – write 'second-hand shop', 'upper secondary school (videregående skole)', 'bachelor's degree', 'thesis' or 'courses' instead.

ui.ctaText: Upload your CV, paste a job ad and get an honest assessment of how well you fit – plus a CV and cover letter tailored to the job.

ui.hubDescription: Practical advice in English for international job seekers applying for jobs in Norway.

languages.name: Dansk
languages.marketNotes: Write for job seekers in Denmark, in natural Danish (not Norwegian). Danish conventions: an 'ansøgning' (motivated application, usually max one page) plus a CV; many employers ask for both; a photo in the CV is common in Denmark but optional. Job portals you may mention by name: Jobindex, Jobnet (the public job portal), LinkedIn. Unemployment insurance funds are called 'a-kasse' and the municipal job centres 'jobcenter'. Do not state rules, amounts, deadlines or legal requirements about a-kasse, dagpenge or jobcenter obligations.

ui.ctaText: Upload dit CV, indsæt et jobopslag og få en ærlig vurdering af, hvor godt du passer – og et CV og en ansøgning tilpasset jobbet.
ui.hubTitle: Artikler om CV, ansøgning og jobsamtale
ui.hubDescription: Praktiske råd om CV, ansøgning og jobsamtale til dig, der søger job i Danmark.
ui.cookieText: Vi vil gerne bruge Google Analytics-cookies til at se, hvordan hjemmesiden bruges. Intet gemmes eller sendes, før du accepterer.

languages.name: Svenska
languages.marketNotes: Write for job seekers in Sweden, in natural Swedish. Swedish conventions: a 'personligt brev' (personal letter, usually max one page, focused on who you are and why this job) plus a CV; many employers use online application forms; a photo in the CV is optional. Job portals you may mention by name: Platsbanken (run by Arbetsförmedlingen), LinkedIn. Do not state rules, amounts, deadlines or legal requirements about Arbetsförmedlingen, a-kassa or activity reporting.

ui.ctaText: Ladda upp ditt CV, klistra in en platsannons och få en ärlig bedömning av hur väl du passar – och ett CV och personligt brev anpassat efter jobbet.

languages.name: Tiếng Việt
languages.market: Người tìm việc Việt Nam, ở Việt Nam và ở nước ngoài (đặc biệt Bắc Âu)
languages.marketNotes: Write in natural Vietnamese with full diacritics, for two groups: job seekers in Vietnam, and Vietnamese people looking for work abroad, especially in the Nordic countries (Norway, Sweden, Denmark). In Vietnam, job portals you may mention by name are TopCV and VietnamWorks, plus LinkedIn; Vietnamese CVs often include more personal details (date of birth, photo) than Nordic CVs do, and a CV for a Nordic employer should follow Nordic norms. Explain differences practically. Do not state visa, work-permit, salary or legal rules for any country.
languages.wordNote: Vietnamesisk telles i stavelser (ord skilt med mellomrom), derfor høyere tall.

ui.ctaText: Tải CV của bạn lên, dán tin tuyển dụng và nhận đánh giá trung thực về mức độ phù hợp – cùng CV và thư xin việc được điều chỉnh theo công việc.
